Spain Investigates Migrant Influx Amid Ceuta Crisis

Spanish authorities have launched a criminal investigation into the influx of thousands of migrants into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. The investigation is reportedly focused on the circumstances surrounding the large-scale arrival of individuals. The crisis saw an unprecedented number of people, including minors, cross into Ceuta from Morocco over a short period. The situation has strained resources and raised humanitarian concerns.
